notes: Contraction mirror of biology-replace-0014: removes the revision's original fact (the temporal lobe is a lobe of the brain). RELATIONS.md tags lobe_of subproperty and chain only, so the contraction check (a functional or many-valued relation) fails until lobe_of also carries functional (a lobe is a division of one organ): the staging merge does not let a later file add a tag to an existing relation (it reports a conflict), so the fix has to go into RELATIONS.md and relation_checks.json (proposal in staging/biology-delete-abox.lobe_of.PROPOSED.md, deliberately not picked up by the staging glob); flagged for the lead. The has_lobe inverse row is staged. The cardinality question is the revision's new value (the liver), a lobe of the liver being a different fact from the one removed. Related near reads the fact through the inverse. Related far is the revision's body-system question. The two derived questions take the organ by description and look up facts stored about the brain by name (skull, cerebrospinal fluid). The old questions about 'part of the nervous system' for the temporal lobe or the hippocampus were dropped: the temporal lobe is independently part of the cerebral cortex, which is part of the brain, so a route survives. Doubt: 'the temporal lobe of the cerebral cortex' remains stored; the contraction removes the 'lobe of the brain' wording only.
